personal_color_faces.mapping_rationale: In seasonal personal color theory, Spring (봄) and Autumn (가을) palettes represent yellow-carotenoid dominant Warm undertones; Summer (여름) and Winter (겨울) palettes represent blue-hemoglobin dominant Cool undertones.

pudding_foundation_shades.mapping_rationale: Cosmetic manufacturers annotate undertone direction explicitly. For MAC Cosmetics, naming convention is inverted (NC neutralizes pink for warm skin, NW neutralizes yellow for cool skin). Contradictory descriptions are omitted.

fitzpatrick_mst_benchmarks.mapping_rationale: Fitzpatrick I-VI and Monk Skin Tone 1-10 measure melanin density / apparent skin lightness, not biological erythema/carotenoid balance (undertone). Per project safety guidelines, they are marked 'unlabeled' for undertone prediction.
